verdict.rationale: The SDK explicitly supports pausing for human input/approval via the canUseTool callback, which fires when Claude needs permission or has clarifying questions, and hooks can block operations before execution pending human decision; sessions persist to disk so execution can resume with the human's decision incorporated. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on/independent example demonstrating a full pause-then-resume-with-decision workflow, and no dedicated 'approval queue' UI pattern beyond the callback/hook primitives.
